title: Fill-Distance-Guided Active Learning for Causal Function Recovery under Network Interference
abstract: arXiv:2611.24143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal inference seeks to learn how outcomes change under alternative interventions, but network interactions complicate this task. Under network interference, outcomes depend on both own treatment and neighbors' treatments, making causal effects functions of neighborhood exposure rather than single treatment contrasts. Existing methods primarily target prespecified causal contrasts or their estimation precision, leaving global response-function recovery largely unexplored. We study sequential experimentation under a limited experimental budget, with the goal of recovering the full exposure-dependent population-average response function. To this end, we propose FANCI (Fill-Distance-Guided Active Learning for Network-Interference Causal Inference). translated_title: 基于填充距离引导的主动学习实现网络干扰下的因果函数恢复
translated_abstract: 因果推断旨在学习结果在不同干预下如何变化，但网络交互使这一任务变得复杂。在网络干扰下，结果同时取决于自身的处理和邻居的处理，这使得因果效应成为邻域暴露的函数，而非单一处理之间的对比。现有方法主要针对预先指定的因果对比或其估计精度，而对全局响应函数恢复的研究几乎处于空白状态。我们研究了有限实验预算下的序贯实验设计问题，目标是恢复完整的、依赖于暴露的总体平均响应函数。为此，我们提出了FANCI（填充距离引导的网络干扰因果推断主动学习方法）。在函数学习方面，针对特定处理的高斯过程灵活地建模非线性的条件响应曲面。在实验设计方面，我们将全局响应函数恢复表述为……
tldr: 该论文提出FANCI方法，在有限实验预算下，利用填充距离引导的主动学习设计与特定处理的建模非线性响应曲面，实现网络干扰环境中完整的暴露依赖总体平均响应函数恢复。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FANCI, a fill-distance-guided active learning framework that uses treatment-specific Gaussian processes to recover the full exposure-dependent population-average response function under network interference within a limited experimental budget.
